name: io.github.risingwavelabs/risingwave-mcp
title: RisingWave
description: Query, inspect and operate RisingWave, the PostgreSQL-compatible streaming database, from an agent.

runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open so the server can speak stdio
runtimeArguments.name: -i

runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the host disconnects
runtimeArguments.name: --rm

runtimeArguments.description: Pass the RisingWave connection string from the host environment
runtimeArguments.name: -e

runtimeArguments.description: Use the stdio transport instead of the image default (streamable HTTP)
runtimeArguments.name: -e

environmentVariables.name: RISINGWAVE_CONNECTION_STR
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for RisingWave, e.g. postgresql://user:password@host:4566/dev. Use a user with SELECT on the views the agent may read.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport the server speaks. The registry package uses stdio; the image defaults to streamable-http.
